summary: Claude models straight from Anthropic. Natively supported by PI - an API key or a Claude Pro/Max subscription login is all it needs.

requires.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
requires.description: Anthropic API key. Optional only because `/login anthropic` (Claude Pro/Max subscription) is an equally valid credential - you need exactly one of the two.
requires.howTo: console.anthropic.com -> API keys. Put it in ~/.pi/secrets.env as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-... (chmod 600). PI also accepts ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (sent as a bearer token, for a gateway that fronts Anthropic) and ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN.

prompts.label: How will you authenticate to Anthropic?

choices.label: API key in ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (installer writes the reference, never the value)
Claude Pro/Max subscription - run `/login anthropic` inside PI after install

prompts.label: Do you have the 1M-token context beta enabled on this account?
prompts.help: Answer no unless you know you do. See the notes below - this decides whether the contextWindow cap stays at 200000.

notes: NOTHING IS REQUIRED FOR THIS PROVIDER TO WORK. `anthropic` is built into PI (wire API `anthropic-messages`, baseUrl https://api.anthropic.com). The block above exists ONLY to correct declared context windows; delete it entirely and the provider still works.

WHY modelOverrides IS HERE TOO. PI's bundled Anthropic catalogue declares contextWindow 1000000 for the Opus/Sonnet 4.6+ family. On the API that window is a beta that has to be enabled on the account, and most accounts are served 200000. The same failure follows as on Copilot: compaction is `contextWindow - reserveTokens`, so a declared 1M window means compaction never fires before the request is already too big. min(200000, what the endpoint actually serves) is the rule; the `longContext` prompt is how you opt out of it deliberately.
{{contextWindow}} IS A NUMBER, NOT A STRING. The installer must substitute it unquoted - `"contextWindow": 200000`, not `"contextWindow": "200000"`. PI will not coerce it.

MODEL IDS USE DASHES HERE, DOTS ON COPILOT. `anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5` and `github-copilot/claude-haiku-4.5` are the same model behind two different id conventions. Getting this wrong produces `model not in the registry` at dispatch time, which is loud but confusing if you have not seen it before.

SUBSCRIPTION LOGIN. `/login anthropic` stores an OAuth credential in ~/.pi/agent/auth.json (0600). Unlike the Copilot OAuth path there is no baseUrl clobbering to worry about: the Anthropic OAuth resolver does not rewrite the endpoint.

EGRESS CLASS IS `public`. Traffic leaves your machine to a third party. If your reason for running this harness is that some material must not leave a boundary, that material must not be routed here - bind the `confidential` tier to a provider you control.

verify.label: PI sees the provider as configured
